name: 2014 Girly
summary: The aesthetic resurfaced on social media app TikTok between late 2022 and reached its peak in summer 2024, following the "2024 is the new 2014" trend, due to users longing for the energy it gave.
description: The aesthetic resurfaced on social media app TikTok between late 2022 and reached its peak in summer 2024, following the "2024 is the new 2014" trend, due to users longing for the energy it gave.
culturalContext: Key values (per the Aesthetics Wiki): kindess, femininity, and being grateful. most values are learnt from Audrey Hepburn

visualDNA.colour: Various shades of pink, cream white, beige, and mint

fashion.Overview: The fashion is related to the Basic Girl, with more girly pieces like the Pink Cloud UGG boots, it can contain luxury pieces too, like the limited version Victoria's Secret silk pajamas. People, especially bloggers participating in the aesthetic, usually wear:
fashion.Upper clothes: Pink cardigans; Comfy sweatshirts; Victoria's Secret camisoles; Lace camisoles; Pastel sweaters; Plain white t-shirts; Victoria's Secret dressing gowns; Pink winter jackets; Denim jackets; peplum tops; bustiers
fashion.Underclothes: Black or grey leggings; Light-wash skinny jeans (for a really basic look); Sweatpants (especially in pink, grey and sometimes black); Lace/girly undies; Tennis skirts; Denim Jeans/shorts
fashion.Pajamas: Silk pajamas (especially striped ones); Victoria's Secret pajamas; Comfy pajamas with girly textures; brandy Melville pajamas
fashion.Dresses: Pale pink dresses; 1950s inspired dresses; white lace dresses; floral dresses
fashion.Shoes: White Converses; Pink UGG boots; White heels; ballet flats
fashion.Accessories: Participants could take inspiration from Ariana's Grande outfits as well, such as wearing pastel mini-skirts, high heels, and crop tops.
fashion.Makeup: The makeup is simple and easy, and often consists of the following:
